attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 12 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives neither man a year: it sets them only «κατά τους χρόνους της βασιλείας του Μαξιμιανού (285 - 305 μ.Χ.)», so there is no `dates` object. Two names in one line, so two folders. The page's couplet makes him the first of the two to be beheaded, which is the only thing on the page that distinguishes them at all. The corpus holds nobody else of this name, and the page prints no hymn.
